source_locators_and_findings.finding: argc<4 alone refuses usage; with normal four/five arguments the process installs fault handlers, loads/binds/initializes the original image, prints optional imports and resolves seven exports BEFORE opening script/output. --imports is a diagnostic addition, not dry-run/help/safety mode.

Script opens r; output opens wb and truncates if present. No exclusive-create, new-directory creation, path restriction or old-payload protection exists. The separate caller must supply fresh absent paths. Missing script can still leave the already opened output truncated.

Allocates L/R/interleaved buffers, reads exactly requested frames from input or silence, copies to in-place channels, selects queued events, resets input flag for each CalcA and writes interleaved stereo floats to output. fread short input is error; fwrite/fclose return values are unchecked. A future successful exit alone is insufficient without byte-count/log/output validation.

Default inst is NULL, input flag0, transport{0,0,0.0,120.0}; no automatic create/rate/params/destroy. Script must provide lifecycle and inflag1. process block size is checked1..65536; arbitrary malformed/negative counts, allocation failures, duplicate create or bad lifecycle are not generally validated. Selected finite script avoids those unsupported forms.

Default MXCSR1f80; enter applies configured MXCSR before each export call and leave restores1f80. Script mxcsr changes future export calls. Transport is not automatically advanced by process. Event-frame selection restarts local done=0 for each process command; selected script uses one process and no events.

Opens bundle O_RDONLY, maps source file privately, selects fat x86_64 slice, requires thin x86_64 Mach-O MH_BUNDLE/MH_DYLIB and supported DYLD_INFO/SYMTAB. Fixed slide0x200000000 MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE mappings, zero fill, rebase/bind/lazy bind, executable protections and static initializer calls are actual original-execution setup if run. Weak binds are explicitly not applied; chained fixups refuse. File/mapping presence is not proof current mapping/symbol/call success.

Resolved code imports pass through counting stubs to their Linux/shim addresses; data imports bind direct addresses. Unbound imports point to individual256-byte PROT_NONE guard slots. This provides diagnostics, not a sandbox or proof all imports are compatible.

Any __mod_init_func entries run before C command interpretation. Current selected Corpus metadata contains no initializer section; this limited parser result does not mean create/rate make no other calls.

SIGSEGV/BUS/ILL/FPE handlers report unbound guard hits as TRAP and exit86; generic fault exits87; low-level stderr write failure exits88. These are process-local effects, not host compatibility. Normal driver errors use exit2.

Exact names select fixed glibc/shims, optionally sensitivity-perturbed math, dynamically resolved libm or libstdc++ RTTI, then custom libc++ bindings. No Cocoa/CoreFoundation/Objective-C or fake com.ableton.live host-identity binding is introduced. Amp/Cabinet remain outside this route.
cxa_atexit registration is no-op, so those destructors do not run. This stub limitation is distinct from the explicit bundle DestroyInstanceU call.

Uses an inferred FreeBSD-lineage Park–Miller rand replacement, seeds state from supplied srand and fixes time to0 unless XDEV_TIME. This is not Apple's shipped libc RNG proof. Even deterministic-shape runs historically used rand during construction; stubs must remain declared.

Handwritten libc++ string/stream/C-locale object-layout shims format default floats at precision6 and may affect save/load round trips. Exceptions/unsupported paths trap; trace environment emits float formatting to stderr. Stream failbit counter is reported, not a general ABI or parsing equivalence proof.
Always recompiles to BIN with gcc -O1 -g -no-pie and four C sources/-ldl/-lm; avoided for the selected already-built entrypoint.
Writes script and invokes subprocess with inherited/merged environment; output is read with numpy. No import/main of this helper was needed or run in prep.
Builds, rewrites input vectors, renders broad batches/variants under old packet paths and rewrites results; not a safe direct route for one additive capture.

import_substitutions.ordinary_host: glibc memory/allocation/string/stdio functions; libm numerical functions from existing libm.so.6; libstdc++ __dynamic_cast and three Itanium RTTI type_info vtables.
import_substitutions.replaced_mac_runtime: C-locale newlocale/mask/rune tables, memset_pattern16, packed sincos return shims, exp10 shims, stderr data pointer, custom stack guard/failure, allocation/delete wrappers and no-op cxa_atexit.
import_substitutions.custom_cpp: Handwritten std::__1 strings, locales/ctype and stream operations/layouts; unsupported throwing/deleting-base-destructor cases trap rather than general libc++ emulation.
import_substitutions.sensitivity: XDEV_LIBM_ULP nonzero perturbs selected libm results by nextafter; selected0 means no perturb. XDEV_TIME0 controls time-derived seed; XDEV_TRACE_OSTREAM absent avoids optional trace noise. Whole import-name table was read; no new hooks requested.
import_substitutions.historical_usage: Old sine log contains used import counts, rand/time and cxx-failbits0. These old counts/log successes are historical, not current capability or a newly measured import path. --imports/used/failbits in a later capture must be retained separately.
import_substitutions.original_imports: Current selected Corpus metadata has127 undefined symbols, only libc++.1.dylib and libSystem.B.dylib declarations, and all7 required exports. This review does not claim all127 resolve or all resolved imports behave correctly on the present host.
